newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINLAND HAS GOOD CHANCES TO JOIN EMU - DUTCH BANKER.
newsitem.headline: FINLAND HAS GOOD CHANCES TO JOIN EMU - DUTCH BANKER.

text.p: Finland has good chances to be among the first members of Europe's economic and monetary union (EMU), said Arnout Wellink, the next president of the the Dutch central bank.
"Overall... the chances of Finland being among the first members of monetary union in Europe can be rated as high," Wellink said in the text of a prepared speech.

Wellink said he was impressed by Finland's progress after it was hit by recession with mounting deficits and debt, a depreciating currency, high interest rates and current account deficit and a banking crisis just a few years ago.

"By pursuing a credible and consistent policy, aimed at price stability, reduction of deficits, and structural reform, much of this has been reversed. Inflation now is among the lowest in Europe, while interest rates have converged to the German level," he said.
Wellink is due to succeed Wim Duisenberg as head of the Dutch central bank in June.
